title: Kissed Tangy Chinese Chicken Scallion Pancake
description: A tangy and pillowy Chinese dish featuring chicken stock, perfect for midnight cravings, this scallion pancake is a sugar-free friendly delight. It is made in a kadhai vessel.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add the sliced scallions, minced garlic, and grated ginger to the bowl and mix well.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the chicken stock, sesame oil, and eggs.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Heat a kadhai vessel over medium heat and add 1 tablespoon of sesame oil.
Place a dough circle in the kadhai and cook for 2 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Repeat the cooking process with the remaining dough circles.
Serve the scallion pancakes hot and enjoy.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
